title: Red Sea / Bab-el-Mandeb attacks continue to disrupt Suez transit
summary: Ongoing attacks on commercial vessels; most major carriers reroute around the Cape of Good Hope, adding roughly 10-14 days and higher fuel/insurance cost to Asia-Europe voyages.

title: Black Sea shipping insurance premiums elevated
summary: War-risk insurance premiums remain elevated for Black Sea calls; grain corridor intermittently constrained.

title: Taiwan Strait military exercises raise transit caution
summary: Periodic military exercises prompt some carriers to add buffer time through the Taiwan Strait; no closures but heightened caution.
